description: Escalation Trigger Rules -- deterministic escalation decisions for self-correction loops, repeated failures, and deadlocks. Three sensitivity profiles (relaxed, balanced, aggressive) control thresholds. Each trigger maps to an action: escalate_to_human, retry_with_feedback, or abort.

relaxed.description: Higher tolerance for iteration. Suitable for exploratory or low-risk work.

balanced.description: Default profile. Balances thoroughness with forward momentum.

aggressive.description: Low tolerance for iteration. Suitable for time-sensitive or high-confidence work.

idea.note: Uses profile default. Idea stage is quick validation.

refine.note: Uses profile default. PRD quality requires iteration.

architect.note: Uses profile default. Architecture decisions are consequential.

plan.note: Uses profile default. Plan readiness is straightforward.

development.note: Uses profile default. Code iteration may need more cycles.

uat.note: Uses profile default. UAT is final gate.

triggers.name: max_iterations_reached
triggers.description: Self-correction loop has reached the configured maximum iteration count for the active sensitivity profile.

triggers.name: repeated_validator_failure
triggers.description: The same validator has failed consecutively N times, where N meets or exceeds the repeated_failure_threshold for the active sensitivity profile.

action_metadata.reason_template: repeated validator failure: {run.repeated_failures.validator_name} failed {run.repeated_failures.max_consecutive} consecutive evaluations

triggers.name: adversarial_confidence_below_floor
triggers.description: Adversarial review confidence score is below the configured floor for the active sensitivity profile. Indicates the work product has not met the minimum quality bar after adversarial challenge.

triggers.name: no_progress_detected
triggers.description: Consecutive iterations have produced identical or substantively unchanged outputs, indicating the loop is stuck without making forward progress.

triggers.name: decision_deadlock
triggers.description: Multiple collaboration patterns (debate, consensus) have failed to reach agreement within the configured threshold of rounds.

action_metadata.reason_template: decision deadlock: {run.collaboration_pattern} failed to converge after {run.deadlock_rounds} rounds (threshold: {resolved.decision_deadlock_threshold})

triggers.name: critical_gate_failure_strict_mode
triggers.description: A blocking gate criterion has failed and strict_mode is enabled. No retry is permitted -- immediate escalation to human.

action_metadata.reason_template: strict mode: critical gate failure in {run.gate_result.gate_id}, no retry permitted

evaluation_order_rationale: Strict mode abort checked first (hard stop). Then max iterations (cheapest check). Then no-progress (stall detection). Then repeated failure (per-validator). Then deadlock (multi-agent). Then adversarial confidence (may trigger retry rather than escalate).

escalate_to_human.description: Halt the current loop and present the situation to the human operator with options.

retry_with_feedback.description: Re-enter the self-correction loop with specific feedback from the trigger evaluation. Tracks retry count; escalates to human after max_retries_before_escalate.

abort.description: Halt the pipeline entirely. Used in strict mode or unrecoverable situations.

resolution_protocol.description: How thresholds are resolved across layers.
resolution_protocol.merge_semantics: Scalars: last-writer-wins. Per-stage overrides: shallow-merge with profile defaults.
